```{r}
df.RDF_data <- read.csv('../Results/250826_SSF_rdf_plot_data.csv')%>%
  mutate(filename = str_extract(treatment, "[^/\\\\]+$")) %>%
  mutate(channel = str_replace_all(channel, "SURF6", "SSF1"))
```
```{r}
print(unique(df.RDF_data$filename))
```


```{r fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 5}
df.RDF_plot <- df.RDF_data %>%
  group_by(channel, distance) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    mean_norm_intensity = mean(norm_intensity),
    se_norm_intensity = sd(norm_intensity) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_se_min = mean_norm_intensity - se_norm_intensity,
    mean_se_max = mean_norm_intensity + se_norm_intensity
  )
ggplot(df.RDF_plot , aes(x = distance,  y = mean_norm_intensity, color = channel, fill = channel)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_se_min, ymax = mean_se_max), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Radius (um)", y = "Normalized Intensity", title = "RDF Plot")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("rRNA" = "magenta",
                                "DFC" = "red",
                                "FC" = "orange",
                                "GC" = "green",
                                "SSF1" = "blue"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("rRNA" = "magenta",
                                "DFC" = "red",
                                "FC" = "orange",
                                "GC" = "green",
                                "SSF1" = "blue"))#+ 
#  theme(legend.position = 'none')
```
